summary: The code is syntactically valid and imports are fine. It implements a basic agent-based mask adoption model with households, workplaces, locations, media, and a supply mechanism. However, it falls short of the specified task in several critical areas: many required entities/attributes/behaviors/parameters/metrics are missing or only partially implemented; the main() function does nothing; several logic paths are unused or inconsistent; and key evaluation metrics are not computed.

issues.description: Missing many required entities/attributes/behaviors/metrics from the task specification. Notably incomplete Person attributes (e.g., political_orientation, vaccination_status), missing infection dynamics and infection-related metrics (infections_averted, Rt), incomplete PolicyMaker (sanctions, incentives, budget allocation), RetailerSupply (supply shocks), and key metrics (time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption, sustained_adoption_duration, subgroup_disparity_index, campaign_cost_effectiveness).
issues.location: Throughout: class definitions and Simulation data/metrics collection
issues.solution: Extend entities to include specified attributes and behaviors. Implement interactions per spec (peer influence with homophily, policy enforcement with fines/access control, media messaging with misinformation, supply shocks). Add epidemiological coupling (optional) with R0 and infectious period to compute infections averted and Rt. Compute required metrics and expose them.

issues.description: main() is defined but contains only 'pass', so nothing runs when main() is called as required by the system.
issues.location: Function main() at top of file
issues.solution: Implement main() to parse configuration (e.g., from environment or default), instantiate Simulation, run sim, and output results (e.g., print or save series/metrics).

issues.description: Evaluation metrics specified in the configuration (e.g., time_to_50_percent_adoption, peak_adoption, sustained_adoption_duration, subgroup_disparity_index, policy_enforcement_events, mask_inventory_outage_days) are not computed or returned.
issues.solution: Add post-run metric computation functions to derive the required metrics from series and counters (e.g., compute days to 50%, peak adoption value/day, sustained adoption duration above threshold, enforcement events, stockout days). Return these in a metrics dictionary.

issues.description: Supply logic contains dead/unreached branches and inconsistencies. The branch 'with_supply and not self.retailers' never executes because retailers are always created when with_supply is True. Stockout_days counter for non-retailer pathway is effectively unused.
issues.solution: Choose one supply model (central pool or retailers) or make it configurable and ensure only the chosen path is executed. Initialize central supply stock when using central supply. Remove dead code or guard creation of retailers by config.

issues.description: WorkplaceSchool.enforce_policy_on_attendees is never used in the daily step; local enforcement effects are not integrated.
issues.solution: Invoke enforce_policy_on_attendees during Simulation.step for attendees and apply resulting enforcement actions to agent compliance and enforcement counters.

issues.description: Risk/efficacy updates mix conceptually different signals (e.g., perceived_mask_efficacy pulled toward policy_signal_global, which may not represent efficacy).
issues.location: Simulation.step (per-agent updates of perceived_mask_efficacy and risk_perception)
issues.solution: Separate constructs: use media and education campaigns to influence efficacy beliefs; use prevalence and messaging to influence risk perception; avoid directly using a generic policy signal as a target for efficacy.

issues.description: Household and workplace assignment do not reflect provided distributions; households have fixed maximum size of 3 and no household_size_distribution parameter usage.
issues.solution: Sample household sizes from provided household_size_distribution; similarly sample workplace sizes from distribution and assign agents accordingly.

issues.description: Income deciles are recomputed by sorting incomes every day to compute a Gini index, despite incomes being static.
issues.location: Simulation._income_deciles called daily via _adoption_gini_by_income_deciles in Simulation.step
issues.solution: Precompute decile groupings once during initialize and reuse them each day to avoid O(N log N) sorts per day.

issues.description: Retailer restocking uses government allocation each day and ignores Retailer.restock_inventory() and supply_shock_probability.
issues.solution: Either use Retailer.restock_inventory with restock_rate and add supply shocks per spec, or keep centralized allocation but model shocks (probabilistic restock reduction/price spikes).

issues.description: The variable retailer_stockout_days accumulates the count of stockout retailers per day (sum) rather than actual 'days with stockouts'. Naming is misleading.
issues.solution: Track both: per-day boolean of any stockout to count days and/or maintain a cumulative retailer-out-of-stock count separately with a clear name.
